lesson.grammar_point: present simple affirmative (I work / she works) + possessives my, your, her

listenings.text: Hello Giovanna, this is Paulo from the site office. Daniel Parker works with us this week. He starts at eight in the morning. He works in the office in the morning, and he visits the tunnel in the afternoon. My phone is on all day. Please call me. Thank you.

I live in a small apartment near the station. I walk to the office every day, and it takes fifteen minutes. I like my city. It is big and it is noisy, but the people are very kind. On Saturday I do not work. I go to the movies with my friends.

extra_audio.text: Giovanna arrives at the office in the morning. She works with the plans of the project. After lunch she goes to the site. She checks the tunnel with her team. In the evening she goes home.

paras: Carla Nunes is a civil engineer. She works at Metro Line Nine, the same company as Giovanna. She lives in this city, and she comes to the office every day.
Carla works in two places. In the office she works with the plans of the project. On the site she checks the tunnel with her team.
Her project is a new metro station. The project starts in March and it finishes in December.
Carla likes her job. She says: "My office is small, but my site is very big."
